title: WordPress and Joomla pictures are deleted through media.delete: previewed, confirmed by the customer, reported honestly
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/site-call.test.mjs
S2: Read the test lines named in run.tests.
expect: The first media.delete call sends the plugin a dry_run and answers CONFIRM_FIRST with the files, total size and where the picture is used; the real delete reaches the plugin only after the customer answers that question.
A call with dry_run: true stays a preview even with confirm present, and its next names no receipt, no landed change and no apply_id for undo.
A preview of one attachment cannot confirm the delete of a different one.
With storageDeleted: false the next lists filesLeft and never says the file or the old URL is gone.
A dry run over the 8 MiB undo-copy cap answers too_large without asking the customer.
An older plugin's unknown-action refusal says the plugin needs updating and never falls back to shell or file tools.
evidence: Issue #1339: asked to delete a picture, the agent deleted it with the shell or file tools and said the old URL no longer worked while the CDN still served it (cache-control max-age=14400, second request cf-cache-status HIT).
fence: tracy_site's call path with a fake plugin answer; not a proof against a live WordPress or Joomla site, which needs the Claude Cowork plugin release carrying media.delete.

tests: media.delete previews first, then deletes once only after the door confirmation is answered
media.delete dry_run remains a preview even when confirm is present
a preview-only media.delete exchange cannot confirm a different attachment
media.delete with storageDeleted:false lists filesLeft and never claims storage or URL removal
media.delete refuses before confirmation when dry run exceeds undo-copy cap
media.delete on an old Claude Cowork plugin reports its refusal and never falls back
